titles.romaji: Shinran Shounin to Ousha-jou no Higeki
titles.english: Shinran Shounin to Ousha-jou no Higeki
titles.native: 親鸞聖人と王舎城の悲劇

description:
A spin-off of Sekai no Hikari: Shinran Shounin. It covers the life of Shinran Shounin and his involvement to develop the Mahayana Buddism branch.

(Source: Wikipedia)
